name: buzz
title: Buzz
description: Browse channels, search messages, send direct messages, and set your status in Buzz
author: caasols

commands.name: search-messages
commands.title: Search Messages
commands.description: Full-text search across Buzz channel messages

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Send Message
commands.description: Post a message to a Buzz channel, conversation, or person

commands.name: set-status
commands.title: Set Status
commands.description: View your current status and apply, create, edit or delete reusable status presets, or set a custom status

preferences.name: relayUrl
preferences.title: Relay URL
preferences.description: Your Buzz relay base URL. https:// or wss:// (wss is converted automatically)

preferences.name: privateKey
preferences.title: Private Key
preferences.description: Your Nostr private key (nsec1... or 64-character hex). Stored by Raycast; never leaves your machine.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
